model.name: Northbridge Logistics
model.role: Code of Conduct · Logistics · Columbus, OH
model.about: At Northbridge, we do the right thing, even when it's hard. We keep honest records: every hour, every invoice, every delivery. We protect confidential information about our customers and our people. We don't accept gifts that could influence our decisions. If you see something that doesn't feel right, speak up. We will never retaliate against anyone who raises a concern in good faith.

en: Northbridge Logistics, a transportation and logistics company in Ohio.
Rule 1: keep honest records (hours, invoices, deliveries). Rule 2: speak up, with a promise of no retaliation. It also mentions confidentiality and gifts.
Clear and friendly. It uses “we” and short sentences, not legal language.
“We do the right thing, even when it's hard.”
I liked that it is short and easy to remember. I'd improve: say how to report a concern (a manager, HR or a helpline).
es: Northbridge Logistics, una empresa de transporte y logística en Ohio.
Regla 1: llevar registros honestos (horas, facturas, entregas). Regla 2: alzar la voz, con la promesa de no represalias. También menciona la confidencialidad y los regalos.
Claro y amigable. Usa “we” y oraciones cortas, no lenguaje legal.
“We do the right thing, even when it's hard.”
Me gustó que es corto y fácil de recordar. Mejoraría: decir cómo reportar una inquietud (un gerente, Recursos Humanos o una línea de ayuda).

original.goal: Reading actual codes of conduct helps you understand the ethical expectations U.S. companies place on employees—and the language they use to describe them.
original.goal_es: Leer códigos de conducta reales te ayuda a entender las expectativas éticas que las empresas de EE. UU. tienen para sus empleados, y el lenguaje que utilizan para describirlas.
original.title: Company Codes of Conduct
original.body_en:
🧠 Research Task

Title: Company Codes of Conduct
Time: 1–1.5 hours

Task:

Choose two U.S. companies (for example, Google, Walmart, Deloitte).

Search their websites for "Code of Conduct" or "Ethics Policy."

Identify two rules or values from each company.

Compare:

What behaviors do they emphasize?

How similar or different are the codes?

Which one do you personally find clearer or more inspiring?

Why This Matters:
Reading actual codes of conduct helps you understand the ethical expectations U.S. companies place on employees—and the language they use to describe them.
original.body_es:
🧠 Tarea de Investigación

Título: Códigos de Conducta de Empresas
Tiempo: 1–1.5 horas

Tarea:

Elige dos empresas de EE. UU. (por ejemplo, Google, Walmart, Deloitte).

Busca en sus sitios web "Code of Conduct" (Código de Conducta) o "Ethics Policy" (Política de Ética).

Identifica dos reglas o valores de cada empresa.

Compara:

¿Qué comportamientos enfatizan?

¿Qué tan similares o diferentes son los códigos?

¿Cuál encuentras personalmente más claro o inspirador?

Por qué Esto Importa:
Leer códigos de conducta reales te ayuda a entender las expectativas éticas que las empresas de EE. UU. tienen para sus empleados, y el lenguaje que utilizan para describirlas.
